name: Llamascape
rootCause: The project behind the Llamaverse, the Llamascape NFT series, was hacked. Hackers targeted their Discord server and scammers took around 30-40 ETH.

descriptions.text: The project behind the Llamaverse, the Llamascape NFT series, was hacked. Hackers targeted their Discord server and scammers took around 30-40 ETH.

On 20 May 2022, Llamascape suffered a security breach through Discord social engineering, with the attacker using signer phishing to steal around $70,000 worth of assets on Ethereum. A scammer compromised Llamascape's Discord server and tricked users into signing fraudulent transactions (signer phishing), facilitating unauthorized asset transfers.
